publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
title: Compendium of India's Fertility and Mortality Indicators 1971-2013 based on the Sample Registration System (SRS) - bigger States, Table 1
licence: Government of India publication; reuse with attribution to the source
method: Infant mortality rate (Total column, col. 11) of each bigger State's Table 1, transcribed for 1971-2003 from pdftotext -raw output of the compendium; source_page is the PDF page.
coverage: 19 bigger States/UT: AP, AS, BR, CT, DL, GJ, HR, JK, JH, KA, KL, MP, MH, OR, PB, RJ, TN, UP, WB; first printed IMR year varies (1971, 1972, 1981, 1990, 1999, 2000). All-India not repeated here (already in series_history.csv from the same compendium).
limitations: Sample-based estimates with sampling error, printed as whole numbers. Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh rows from 1999 are starred as excluding Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Uttarakhand, so 1999 is a territorial break. Andhra Pradesh undivided throughout. J&K: no returns 1991-1997 and IMR printed only from 2000; Delhi IMR printed only from 1990. Smaller States/UTs have no IMR in their Table 1 and are not included.

publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
title: Census of India 2001 - Where and How People Live? Data on Housing Stock, Household Amenities and Assets - Jammu and Kashmir Key Results (presentation PDF)
licence: Government of India publication; reuse with attribution to the source
method: State key-results slides from the 2001 Houselisting and Housing Census; State column read from pdftotext -raw text. Every recorded value was cross-checked against State-level counts in Census 2001 tables H-08, H-09, H-11 and H-13 (within 0.05 points after rounding); values that failed were left out.
coverage: Jammu and Kashmir (and India column), Census 2001, total (rural+urban) households.
limitations: Slides print one decimal. Latrine is printed only as 'No latrine' within the house, so latrine-within-premises is not recorded from this deck. The India 'Kerosene' column on the cooking-fuel slide differs between decks (6.5 or 9.8); LPG values used here were each checked against the H-11 table.
